title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: This programme aims to improve the resilience of vulnerable populations living in Beni, Grand Nord Kivu in the Democratic Republic of Congo. It does this by improving the capacity of vulnerable displaced, returnee and host families, to cope with recurring shocks such as natural disasters and conflict. The objectives of the grant is to provide cash transfers and life skills training for households from fragile communities that have recently been affected by crisis; to ensure the safe and timely access to life-saving food and non-food items; and to support households to protect and rebuild their livelihoods,OBJECTIVES: Households are more resilient to shocks (natural disasters,v conflict, displacement, …)OUTCOMES: Improving the resilience and the capacity of vulnerable populations in North Kivu to cope with recurring shocks
